cache_policy.ordered_step_cache: one-step records only (see ordered_step_cache); replayed steps are identical to checked ones

completed_seconds_scope: loading, retained evaluation, artifact serialization and optional numerical reference; scalar input preparation is recorded separately

dimension_binding.scope: exact fixture trace dimension; all public evaluations share this binding

execution.scope: identical results for every core count and arithmetic; n_cores sets the scheduler (4L/5L), modular, frontend, post-processing and route-verification workers; with more than one scheduler thread the 5L reduction_math_seconds is not reported

payload.note: 122 MB; not copied into the gallery (count and sha256 only)

guards.scope: sufficient conditions, including scalar preparation; exact exceptional-domain equality is not inferred from equal results

intrinsic_memoization_scope: Ordered has no completed-result memo; checked opaque factorization may use a fresh isolated internal memo

memory_after_retained_reduction.scope: Linux whole-process RSS; peak includes preparation/loading and earlier stages

preparation.timing_scope: scalar preparation precedes retained evaluation; loaded-bundle historical work is not added to current timing

reduction_math_timing.incompleteness_reason: build lacks the experimental-rustred timing capture feature

retained_reduction_seconds_scope: complete retained public call, including frontend and finalization; separate from reduction math

worker_policy.scope: single owner preparation worker required for native timing subtraction

gallery_provenance.recorded: on 2026-11-06 by the vakint integration gate (vakint commit fa3d27d2f, release build, staged data v0.2.1)
gallery_provenance.sanitized: local data path and worker pid removed; every measurement unchanged
